Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: January 13, 2026

Kids Hurt Too Hawai'i respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information on our website (kidshurttoo.org).

Information We Collect

We collect information you choose to provide:

  • Contact information when you reach out via our contact form (name, phone, email)
  • Information submitted to us when contacted directly via email
  • Email address if you sign up for our newsletter
  • We display our social media content using Curator.io, a third-party service. Curator.io may collect certain technical data (such as IP addresses and browser information) to provide and improve their service. We do not have access to this data and it is governed by their own Privacy Policy; please review for more information.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information only to:

  • Respond to your inquiries
  • Send occasional updates (with opt-out option)
  • Improve your website experience

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information.

Donations

When you make a donation through links on our site, you'll be directed to a secure third-party payment processor. We do not receive or store your payment information.

Cookies

Our website uses essential cookies for site functionality, such as session cookies.
You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect some site features.

Your Rights

You can:

  • Ask what information we have about you
  • Request we delete your information (contact form submissions, etc.)
  • Opt-out of communications at any time

To exercise these rights, contact us at info@kidshurttoo.org.

Children's Privacy

Our website is intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy occasionally. The current version will always be posted here with the effective date.

Contact Us

Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact us:

Email: info@kidshurttoo.org
Phone: 808-545-5683
Mail: 245 N. Kukui St. #102, Honolulu, HI 96817


This Privacy Policy is provided as a general template. Organizations should review all policies with their own legal counsel to ensure compliance with local, state, and federal laws.

Kids Hurt Too Hawaiʻi

The name “Kids Hurt Too” was chosen by children in 2006. In 2011, the official name of the organization became “Kids Hurt Too Hawaiʻi.” Since its beginning, Kids Hurt Too Hawaiʻi has provided group support and training services to thousands of children, youth, caregivers, and providers.
